name: spreadsheets
description: Create, edit, analyze, visualize, render, and export spreadsheets (XLSX/CSV/TSV) with duya's xlsx office skill.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, analyze, visualize, render, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally. Adds workbook-architecture guidance (tab roles, build structure, formula flow, anchoring, dates, error policy), authored-content writing rules, formatting style guidance, chart patterns, and finance/healthcare/marketing/research domain guides, with LibreOffice-based formula recalculation and a zero-formula-error gate. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, Google Sheet, or CSV file.
interface.shortDescription_zh: 创建和编辑电子表格文件（XLSX/CSV）。
